import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(1+eps)
    S = np.sqrt(T)
    z = (p[0] + p[1]*L + p[2]*L**2 + p[3]*L**3 + p[4]*T + p[5]*T**2 + p[6]*L*T
         + p[7]*L**2*T + p[8]/T + p[9]*L**2/T + p[0]*0.0*S)
    return np.exp(z)
